hooks.command: sh -c 'jq -r .tool_input.command | grep -q "gh pr create" || exit 0; git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null); [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] || exit 0; echo "This branch is $n commit(s) behind origin/main. Bring it up to date with the base branch, re-run the checks and push, then open the pull request." >&2; exit 2'
